about: A person or conversation without a photo shows initials on a color, both from its display name. Initials: drop a leading @, # or !, split at whitespace, dots, underscores and hyphens, and take the first character of the first two parts, uppercased. Color: the index into avatarColors in design/tokens.json is the djb2 hash of the name's UTF-8 bytes (start at 5381, then hash * 33 + byte, wrapping at 64 bits, unsigned) modulo 6.

cases.value: A very long display name that wraps the hash many times over
